plugins.name: afc-lite
plugins.title: AFC Lite (Automated Filament Changer)
plugins.description: Lightweight Automated Filament Changer support for the Snapmaker U1's four toolheads. Ships the AFC, AFC_unit and AFC_lane Klipper extras plus an afc.cfg that maps the four lanes (E0-E3) to the U1 extruders and filament motion sensors, and adds gcode macros for color, material, vendor, map, spool id, weight, tool change and lane/tool unload. Per-lane state feeds the U1's SET_PRINT_FILAMENT_CONFIG so the slicer and screen track what is loaded.
plugins.tagline: Four-lane filament tracking and tool-change macros for the U1.
